correctness.rationale: For two independent symmetric Dirichlet(alpha,...,alpha) vectors, independent gamma quotients remove normalization and prove the full-cross-ratio Hilbert distance is the range of n independent log beta-prime variables. Conditioning on minimum gives exact CDF n∫gα(t)[Gα(t+r)-Gα(t)]^(n-1)dt; dominated convergence and a beta integral give sharp small-r coefficient n B(nα,nα)/B(α,α)^n. Alpha=1 logistic order statistics give 2H_(n-1) exact mean and hypergeometric CDF. Exponential two-sided tails have constant Cα=1/[αB(α,α)]; joint maximum/minimum convergence to independent Gumbels yields αD-2log(nCα)=>U+V, with moment convergence under exponential/double-exponential tail bounds and variance limit π²/(3α²). Independent quadrature checked the exact CDF for (n,alpha,r)=(2,.6,1),(3,1,1),(5,2.5,1.3),(8,1,1), and alpha=1 formula. The infinite extreme-value result uses the standard analytic tail argument, not numerics.
